TEXT:
After Ayase left, the two of us were alone in the 
living room.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...Phew, we managed to get through the greatest 
crisis.
She threw a cushion at me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Like I said, what are you talking about?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Think back to what you said to Ayase just now!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: A-About how you like me... and love me...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Don't bring that up. I was trying hard not to think 
about that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Take responsibility for making my heart beat so 
fast!
"How can I?" ...Before I could ask that.
Her lightly blushing cheeks. Her pink lips.

Their destructive power was so incredible, I 
thought I would die.

Perhaps uneasily wondering why I had no reaction, 
Kirino opened her eyes.

Her eyes were moist, and I felt as if my heart was 
captured by them.

I put one hand on Kirino's head, and gently stroked 
it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Seriously? Even though I'm your little sister?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You're not my little sister. You're my girlfriend, 
remember?

"I'm not related to you by blood, so..." I didn't say 
that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah. Even though you're my little sister, I love you.

I wanted to hear Kirino happily say that kind of 
insult, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's right. I'm a siscon. Got a problem with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hehe... Uhehehe... I love you too.

She clings to me as she says that in a captivating 
voice.

"You smell even better" --if I were to say that, I'd 
get treated like a pervert.
That's why I patted her head and said this instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I don't really get it, but if it pleases you, we can 
hug like this whenever you want.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: As I suspected, you really did steal my underwear.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[font_size=26]Wait! H-Huuuuh?![/font_size] [font_size=26]W-What are you making 
me say!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm not angry... You're my girlfriend now, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I didn't steal them! Don't make me agree using a 
leading question!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't yell. You'll ruin the good mood we have here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: *sigh*... Aaaaah, it turned out like this in the end.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
There's no other girl besides me who can go out 
with you without abandoning you, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm fine as long as you're with me.
Kirino separated herself from me as if escaping.
She sternly pointed at me and said...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: We'll redo this again next time.
